fichas.title: Surface Information in Construction Drawings
fichas.summary: Construction drawings may identify floor, ceiling, and wall surfaces; clear window and door areas; flooring types; and wall and ceiling paint or cladding. Surface quantities are given in square metres to two figures after the decimal point, without deduction of openings. Dimensions and other information may also be included if required.
uses: Identify surface areas and finishes in construction drawings

fichas.title: Symbols for Waterproofing, Drainage, and Related Materials
fichas.summary: A construction-drawing legend shows graphic conventions for waterproofing, drainage, coatings, membranes, surface water, damp, and undisturbed earth. Labeled materials include sealing membranes, vapour barriers, foils, waterproofing membranes, mastic, gravel layers, coatings, filter mats, and plastic drain mesh.
uses: Represent waterproofing, drainage, ground conditions, and related materials in construction drawings

fichas.title: Symbols for Insulation
fichas.summary: A construction-drawing legend provides graphic conventions for insulation and board materials, including general insulation against heat loss and noise, mineral wool, glass fibre, wood fibre, peat fibre, synthetic foam, cork, wood wool boards, gypsum building boards, and plasterboards.
uses: Represent insulation and board materials in construction drawings
